name: pehchaan
description: Pehchaan — a multi-tenant link-in-bio SaaS for Indian creators (original build inspired by Beacons' core loop).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
